<thought>Using the molecular formula C14H18O1S, the DBE (degree of unsaturation) is calculated with the formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. There are no nitrogen atoms, and oxygen and sulfur do not affect the calculation. Thus DBE = 14 - (18/2) + 1 = 14 - 9 + 1 = 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
